name: RS-Recon
aliases: Ray-Distance Volume Rendering for Neural Scene Reconstruction
definition: A novel indoor scene reconstruction method that models the volume density function using the Signed Ray Distance Function (SRDF) instead of the Signed Distance Function (SDF) to address noise and inaccuracies in multi-object scenes.
summary: RS-Recon is a neural scene reconstruction method that replaces standard SDFs with ray-specific Signed Ray Distance Functions to eliminate noise from surrounding surfaces in multi-object indoor scenes.
